messages:
matt: FYI saw a weird perf flip on SM90 vs SM80 in canary. paged-attn kernel chooser is preferring Triton fused on SM90 which is ~20% slower for our mixed-batch workload.

riley: Can you paste the kernel_choice log and repro?

matt: Repro: loadgen mix: seq=4096 (10%), seq=512 (90%), batch distro skewed toward smalls. GPU=A100-SM80 and H100-SM90.

kernel_choice log (SM90):
```
model=orca-7b ctx=4096 batch=8 gpu=sm90 chosen_kernel=triton_fused reason=heuristic_batched_avg latency_p50=46ms latency_p99=210ms
model=orca-7b ctx=4096 batch=32 gpu=sm90 chosen_kernel=triton_fused reason=heuristic_batched_avg latency_p50=150ms latency_p99=620ms
```

(SM80 same run picks cuda_flash_paged for batch>=16 with p50=120ms p99=450ms)

shanice: Wait, triton_fused is slower at high batch on SM90? I thought H100 favors triton kernels.

matt: That's what I expected too. But profiling shows memory copy and kernel launches balloon on the Triton path for paged KV because of extra page table work.

perf-bot: quick microbench: triton_fused (sm90) batch32 seq4096 = 148ms avg, cuda_flash_paged (sm90) batch32 seq4096 = 125ms avg. (--run=5)

riley: Interesting. Is this CUDA version dependent? What driver/runtime?

matt: Test matrix:
- SM80: nvidia-driver 515, cuda 11.8
- SM90: nvidia-driver 535, cuda 12.1

I also tried switching Triton runtime flags and saw variation. Looks like kernel-launch overhead + small memcpy on page-resident KV is worse under Triton launches when the batching heuristic picks many small sub-batches.

riley: Could be our batching heuristic: we compute avg_seq and pick kernel based on mean, which doesn't capture skew. If we split by quantiles we might pick per-subbatch kernel and avoid Triton path for large fractions of requests.

shanice: Proposed quick fix: change heuristic to weight 75p sequence length and penalize kernels with high launch overhead. Pseudocode:
```
score[kernel] = alpha * median_seq + beta * batch_size - gamma * launch_overhead_ms
choose argmax(score)
```

matt: Also KV cold pages: when a request hits an uncached page we do a memcpy fallback that forces Triton fused to re-sync more often. On CUDA path we do a lazy memcpy inside runtime which overlaps better.

perf-bot: profile snippets:
```
# triton_fused (sm90)
nvtx: kernel_launch 0.9ms x 50
cudaMemcpySync 1.2ms x 50
# cuda_flash_paged (sm90)
nvtx: kernel_launch 0.5ms x 50
cudaMemcpyAsync 0.3ms x 50
```

riley: So triaged causes: (1) heuristic misclassifying skewed batches, (2) Triton launch + memcpy pattern worse for paged KV on SM90 driver/runtime combo.

shanice: Action items:
- riley: prototype median-weighted heuristic and run loadgen A/B on SM90/SM80 (priority).
- matt: capture a full perf trace with page-fault events and Triton kernel timelines.
- deploy-bot: roll back canary to previous selection policy if perf > 15% regression.

deploy-bot: canary rollback triggered for cluster=us-west-2-sm90 due to latency regression > 20% (auto).

riley: I'll instrument the chooser to log per-subbatch decisions and add a debug flag to force cuda_flash_paged.

matt: If the heuristic fix looks good we should make it opt-in for Dedicated customers first. Might need a runtime flag because quantization changes kernel profiles too.

shanice: Good. Also open an issue for Triton runtime team: include the launch/mem pattern and ask if driver flags change behavior. @riley can you link the traces?

riley: Will upload traces and post link in this thread in the next message.

matt: Thanks — ping me when traces are up. I have a perf dashboard alert set for this canary so we'll watch. :eyes:
